rows.note: Use this for the everyday sense of having been something in the past, especially a former role or status.

example.english: I had been the manager of this company.
example.traditional: 我以前係呢間公司嘅經理。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 cin4 hai6 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 ging1 lei5

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose rendering when emphasizing that someone or something was once a certain way.

example.english: This place had once been a cinema.
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 cang4 ging1 hai6 jat1 gaan1 hei3 jyun2
